business_summary: Blackrock Municipal 2030 Target Term Trust is a closed end fixed income mutual fund launched by BlackRock, Inc. The fund is managed by by BlackRock Advisors, LLC. It invests in fixed income markets. The fund invests primarily in investment grade municipal bonds that are exempt from regular federal income tax. It was formerly known as BlackRock Municipal Target Term Trust. Blackrock Municipal 2030 Target Term Trust was formed on August 30, 2012 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Blackrock Municipal 2030 Target Term Trust는 BlackRock, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 BlackRock Advisors, LLC가 관리합니다. 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 주로 일반 연방 소득세가 면제되는 투자 등급 지방채에 투자합니다. 이전에는 BlackRock Municipal Target Term Trust로 알려졌습니다. Blackrock Municipal 2030 Target Term Trust는 2012년 8월 30일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
